## How to read this

- **coverage** = observed days / days between first and last observation. Low coverage (e.g. monsoon-only records) means lag/sequence features may not work for that station.
- Decide the modelling branch from this: many stations with high coverage -> sequence + multi-horizon models are possible; otherwise lean on tabular models.
